text_block_list.text:
One day, while shopping in the shopping district,
I heard loud laughter.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahahahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey, listen, listen!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft, ahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh gosh, that was so hilarious, I can barely even talk...!
choice_data_list: Power through it with sheer fighting spirit!
Let's calm down for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Gnnnhhh...! All right, all fired up and ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, so that carrot I saw at the greengrocer's
earlier looked crazy similar to Gold Ship
yawning――

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Nyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—! A cat!?
Wait, ahahahahaha—!
choice_data_list: Wait, what was funny about that?
Wait, what was funny about that?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: T-The whiskers on the left and right are different lengths――

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A-A puppy, squeee!
Ahahaha, it's so freakin' cute!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... I laughed so hard it feels like
I just cranked out 50 sit-ups in seconds...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, crap, is that the time already!?
Didn't I promise to do a tandem workout after this—!?

Afterward, Daitaku Helios took off at breakneck speed,
sprinting back toward the academy.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Gotcha. First, I'll try taking a deep breath!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... exhaaaale...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And next, I'll picture something that makes me feel calm...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right! That speech President Rudolf
gave a while back—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pfft, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... S-Sorry,
the President told a pun and I just couldn't help it...!

Even after that, we tried our best to settle down,
but it only made Daitaku Helios burst into even harder laughter.
